description:
Connect a WhatsApp number from the user's own Meta app: its phone_number_id and waba_id (WhatsApp > API Setup), a permanent access token and the app secret. The easier path for most people is the console, where Connect WhatsApp opens Meta's own sign-up with no app needed; suggest that first. The result has webhook.url and a verify_token, shown once: tell the user to enter both in their Meta app under WhatsApp > Configuration and subscribe to the messages field. Set inbound_agent_id to have an agent answer the number.

Requires scope `whatsapp:write`.

access_token.description: A permanent (system user) access token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management.

app_secret.description: The Meta app's secret, from App settings > Basic. Used to check webhooks come from Meta.

inbound_agent_id.description: Agent that answers the number's chats.

phone_number_id.description: The number's id from WhatsApp > API Setup.

name: create_whatsapp_account
title: Connect a WhatsApp number
